# truefoundry_gateway_otel_config (Resource)

Manages the AI gateway OpenTelemetry configuration: where the gateway ships its traces and metrics. Applied as a `gateway-otel-config` manifest via `PUT /api/svc/v1/apply`. **The OTel config is a tenant-wide singleton** — define at most one of this resource per control plane; an apply replaces the whole manifest, so an omitted exporter is switched off. Import the existing config with `terraform import truefoundry_gateway_otel_config.example gateway-otel-config`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The tenant-wide AI gateway OpenTelemetry config (singleton — define at most
# one): where the gateway ships its traces and metrics.
resource "truefoundry_gateway_otel_config" "otel" {
  otel_traces_exporter_config = {
    type     = "http"
    encoding = "proto" # required for http, invalid for grpc
    endpoint = "https://otel-collector.example.com/v1/traces"

    # Prefer a TrueFoundry secret reference over a raw token.
    headers = {
      authorization = "my-tenant:hashicorp:vault-secrets:secret-store:vault::otel/token"
    }

    additional_resource_attributes = {
      "service.namespace" = "ai-gateway"
      "deployment.env"    = "production"
    }

    # Keep prompts and completions out of the exported spans.
    exclude_request_data = true

    # Export only spans of one gateway cluster; omit `when` to export all.
    when = [
      {
        key   = "tfy_gateway_cluster"
        value = ["production-cluster"]
      },
    ]
  }

  # gRPC exporters take no encoding.
  otel_metrics_exporter_config = {
    type     = "grpc"
    endpoint = "https://otel-collector.example.com:4317"
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `otel_metrics_exporter_config` (Attributes) OTLP exporter the gateway ships metrics to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--otel_metrics_exporter_config))
- `otel_traces_exporter_config` (Attributes) OTLP exporter the gateway ships request traces to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--otel_traces_exporter_config))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Control plane ID of the gateway OTel config.

<a id="nestedatt--otel_metrics_exporter_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `otel_metrics_exporter_config`

Required:

- `endpoint` (String) URL of the collector receiving the metrics.
- `type` (String) OTLP transport. One of: `http`, `grpc`.

Optional:

- `encoding` (String) Payload encoding. One of: `proto`, `json`. Required for `http` exporters, invalid for `grpc`.
- `headers` (Map of String, Sensitive) Headers sent to the collector, e.g. an `authorization` header. Marked sensitive as a whole; prefer a TrueFoundry secret reference over a raw token.


<a id="nestedatt--otel_traces_exporter_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `otel_traces_exporter_config`

Required:

- `endpoint` (String) URL of the collector receiving the traces.
- `type` (String) OTLP transport. One of: `http`, `grpc`.

Optional:

- `additional_resource_attributes` (Map of String) Extra OpenTelemetry resource attributes set on every exported span, e.g. `service.namespace`.
- `encoding` (String) Payload encoding. One of: `proto`, `json`. Required for `http` exporters, invalid for `grpc`.
- `exclude_request_data` (Boolean) Whether prompts and completions are stripped from exported spans.
- `headers` (Map of String, Sensitive) Headers sent to the collector, e.g. an `authorization` header. Marked sensitive as a whole; prefer a TrueFoundry secret reference over a raw token.
- `when` (Attributes List) Exports only spans whose attributes match. Every entry must match; omit the attribute to export all spans. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--otel_traces_exporter_config--when))

<a id="nestedatt--otel_traces_exporter_config--when"></a>
### Nested Schema for `otel_traces_exporter_config.when`

Required:

- `key` (String) Span attribute to match on.
- `value` (Set of String) Values of the span attribute that are exported.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The OTel config is a tenant-wide singleton; its import ID is the fixed
# string "gateway-otel-config".
terraform import truefoundry_gateway_otel_config.otel gateway-otel-config
```
